source_evidence: During the annuity phase, the insurance company makes periodic payments to you. Or, you can choose to receive your contract value in one lump sum.
question: Misconception: During the payout phase of an indexed annuity, the insurer must make periodic payments; taking the contract value as a lump sum is not an option.
answer: The payout phase can provide periodic payments, but a lump-sum payment of the contract value is also an option.
